meta..write: auth != null && ((!data.exists() && newData.child('ownerUid').val() === auth.uid) || (data.exists() && data.child('ownerUid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('ownerUid').val() === auth.uid))

$area..validate: newData.hasChildren(['answeredCount','questionCount','status']) && newData.child('answeredCount').isNumber() && newData.child('answeredCount').val() >= 0 && newData.child('answeredCount').val() <= 10 && newData.child('questionCount').isNumber() && newData.child('questionCount').val() === 10 && newData.child('status').isString()

newData.hasChildren(['score','answeredCount','completedAt']) && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() <= 100 && newData.child('answeredCount').isNumber() && newData.child('answeredCount').val() === 10 && newData.child('completedAt').isNumber()

$attemptId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['area','score','answeredCount','completedAt']) && newData.child('area').isString() && newData.child('score').isNumber() && newData.child('score').val() >= 0 && newData.child('score').val() <= 100 && newData.child('answeredCount').isNumber() && newData.child('answeredCount').val() === 10 && newData.child('completedAt').isNumber()

$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['area','x','y','word','completedAt']) && newData.child('area').isString() && (newData.child('area').val() === 'highUncomfortable' || newData.child('area').val() === 'highComfortable' || newData.child('area').val() === 'lowUncomfortable' || newData.child('area').val() === 'lowComfortable') && newData.child('x').isNumber() && newData.child('x').val() >= 0 && newData.child('x').val() <= 1 && newData.child('y').isNumber() && newData.child('y').val() >= 0 && newData.child('y').val() <= 1 && newData.child('word').isString() && newData.child('word').val().length <= 30 && newData.child('completedAt').isNumber()
